pages.title: Dead State — find quests a model wrote that cannot be finished
pages.description: Dead State types generated quest content into a precondition-effect model and searches for orderings of ordinary play that permanently block a quest.

Scope: boolean world facts only · up to 26 facts and 40 actions per batch.
What is real: the three checks run in your browser with no network — press “Re-run checks” and they run live, with the elapsed time measured. The page lands on a recorded run so it is instant and works with no API key; the label says which you are looking at. Extraction of pasted content runs server-side. The shipped samples are real generated content with the provider, model and timestamp recorded on each one. Nothing in the loop is stubbed or mocked.
